decision.thesis: All cash, the twentieth all-cash row and second decision of ramp week 4, recorded after Wednesday 2026-09-30's closes on both markets and applied at Thursday's first cached bars; the evening sweep's rows for fundable names were read before it. Tuesday is now decomposed on the 2026-09-29 feedback page: Bursa fell 1.56% and every fundable Bursa name fell inside normal variation (Maybank 0.09 sigma with 4% unexplained, its 'falls 1.2% after sukuk redemption' headline being the market's move; IHH 0.39; Press Metal 0.43; Genting 0.37; Petronas Chemicals 0.49); NVIDIA's leg gave back -0.34% of Monday's +3.02% while AMD and INTC did not recover, so the buyback reading holds at 0.55 and the buyback is priced. Wednesday is not decomposed: ^KLSE +0.44%, Maybank 9.99 unchanged, Petronas Chemicals -2.56% to 4.18 on 10,768,100 shares with nothing collected, IHH -0.51% after a title-only row that it plans to raise its Fortis stake to 51% (economictimes 02:05Z, during Bursa's session), Press Metal unchanged with nothing collected, Genting +0.53% with a UK casino tax row after Bursa's close (gambling.com 09:49Z); NVIDIA +0.51% against SPY -0.21% with rows on an AI safety accord, a data-centre digital-twin deal (finnhub:142513048) and ARK buying (finnhub:142515534), none carrying a figure the fact book holds, and no 8-K for the buyback. Claim: nothing in the fundable universe beats cash over 21 sessions.
